A '''blacksmith''' is one who works metal. Typically they are very large and wide shouldered men, as they spend hours pounding out and shaping metal. 

Aiel afford blacksmiths a high amount of respect, presumably due to their skills in making weapons, as well as their place in Aiel customs.

== [[Perrin Aybara]] ==
Perrin is apprenticed to [[Haral Luhhan]], blacksmith of [[Emond's Field]]. Though he is in essence now Perrin, Lord of the Two Rivers, he still thinks of himself as a simple blacksmith.
